title: 实验室人员人机工效培训
source_doc: course/Lab Safety Training Series/04_Lab Worker Ergonomics Training - [Lab Safety Training].md
author_source: project/Lab Safety Training Series/04_Lab Worker Ergonomics Training - [Lab Safety Training]/src.py

points.K1: 每项任务都在考验身体
points.K17: 坐姿：腰有支撑，脚有着落

shots.scene: 欣欣站在可升降的实验台旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a height-adjustable lab bench and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲实验室里的人机工效。
overlay: 实验室人员人机工效培训

shots.scene: 手腕、肩膀、眼睛、腰背四个身体部位图标
shots.prompt_en: Four simple body icons in a row: a wrist, a shoulder, an eye and a lower back. No people.
shots.narration: 护好手腕、肩膀、眼睛和腰背。

shots.scene: 阿杰踮着脚、伸长手臂在高台面上移液，表情吃力
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands on tiptoe and stretches his arm to pipette at a bench that is too high for him, looking strained.
shots.narration: 阿杰移液一上午，胳膊又酸又麻。

shots.scene: 阿杰揉着手腕和后颈
shots.prompt_en: The young male student rubs his wrist and the back of his neck with a tired face.
shots.narration: 手腕疼，脖子也僵了。

shots.scene: 小研帮他调低座椅，把试管架挪到身前
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lowers his chair and moves the tube rack closer, right in front of him.
shots.narration: 小研帮他调椅子、挪架子。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 小调整，能省下大麻烦。

shots.section_title: 每项任务都在考验身体
shots.scene: 称量、移液、看显微镜、搬箱子四个任务图标
shots.prompt_en: Four task icons: weighing on a balance, pipetting, looking into a microscope and carrying a box. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室每天有各种各样的任务。
overlay: 每项任务都在考验身体

shots.section_title: 每项任务都在考验身体
shots.scene: 不同工位的图标，身体轮廓上亮起不同部位
shots.prompt_en: A body outline with different joints glowing as task icons change around it. No people.
shots.narration: 工位、仪器、动作不同，身体负担也不同。

shots.section_title: 每项任务都在考验身体
shots.scene: 身体轮廓上的肩颈处出现红色酸痛标记
shots.prompt_en: A body outline with small red ache marks on the neck and shoulders. No people.
shots.narration: 不留意，就会积成劳损。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着工作台、仪器、工具三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at three icons: a workbench, an instrument and a hand tool.
shots.narration: 人机工效看的是活儿、工位、仪器和工具。

shots.scene: 人体轮廓和工作台之间一个双向箭头
shots.prompt_en: A body outline and a workbench icon connected by a two-way arrow with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 让工作方式适应自己的身体。

shots.scene: 效率和安全两个图标并排打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two icons side by side with green checks: a speedometer and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 干得顺手，也干得安全。

shots.scene: 高矮不同的小研和阿杰并排站在同一张实验台前
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student, of clearly different heights, stand side by side at the same lab bench.
shots.narration: 你个子高还是矮？手臂长还是短？

shots.scene: 身体轮廓上压力箭头变少
shots.prompt_en: A body outline where many pressure arrows shrink to just a few. No people.
shots.narration: 安全工作，就是少给身体加压。

shots.scene: 一排同样高度的实验台，一群高矮不同的小人图标
shots.prompt_en: A row of identical benches next to many person pictograms of different heights. No people.
shots.narration: 台子和设备只能照顾大多数人。

shots.scene: 阿杰和老周一起调整工位
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the older man adjust his workstation together, moving the chair and the rack.
shots.narration: 按自己调好工位，你和导师一起来。

shots.scene: 合适的工位让关节图标变成绿色
shots.prompt_en: Joint icons on a body outline turn from red to green as a workstation icon fits it. No people.
shots.narration: 合得越好，肌肉关节越轻松。

shots.scene: 五个原因图标排成一列
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a column: an overstretched arm, a looping arrow, a twisted body, a heavy weight, and a wrong tool. No people.
shots.narration: 劳损的主要原因有这五个。

shots.scene: 每个原因图标被依次打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Each of the five cause icons gets a red X one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 尽量避开它们。

shots.scene: 小研在实验台旁伸展肩膀
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stretches her shoulders beside her lab bench.
shots.narration: 常做拉伸，缓解肌肉紧张。

shots.scene: 身体轮廓处在自然直立姿势，周围标绿
shots.prompt_en: A body outline in a relaxed upright neutral posture with green highlights. No people.
shots.narration: 尽量让身体保持在中立姿势。

shots.scene: 每个关节旁一个绿色对勾
shots.prompt_en: A body outline with small green check marks at the wrist, elbow, shoulder, neck and lower back. No people.
shots.narration: 每个关节都有自己的中立姿势。

shots.scene: 手腕伸直、像要握手的手部图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a straight wrist and open hand as if ready for a handshake, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 手腕伸直，就像准备和人握手。

shots.scene: 手腕上翘、下弯的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons of a wrist bent sharply up and sharply down, each crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 弯着、翘着，压力大得多。

shots.scene: 时钟图标旁的弯曲手腕出现红色酸痛
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon next to a bent wrist icon with red ache marks. No people.
shots.narration: 时间一长，伤得更明显。

shots.scene: 小研在台前操作，上臂贴身，前臂平放
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works at a bench with her upper arms close to her sides and forearms level.
shots.narration: 上臂贴着身体两侧，

shots.scene: 肘部成直角的示意图
shots.prompt_en: A side-view diagram of an arm with the elbow bent at a right angle and a small angle mark. No people.
shots.narration: 前臂大约成直角，肩膀最轻松。

shots.scene: 欣欣转动升降椅的调节杆
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot adjusts the lever of a height-adjustable lab chair.
shots.narration: 台面高度，是保持中立姿势的关键。

shots.scene: 小研坐下，手肘与台面平齐
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sits at a bench with her elbows level with the work surface.
shots.narration: 坐着，就升降椅子找到合适位置。

shots.scene: 站立时脚下放一个稳固的小平台
shots.prompt_en: A sturdy low platform on the floor in front of a high bench. No people.
shots.narration: 站着够不着，垫个稳固的小平台。

shots.scene: 可升降台面的箭头图标
shots.prompt_en: A height-adjustable bench icon with up and down arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 或者把台面调低一些。

shots.scene: 台面上工具摆在正前方的手臂可及范围内
shots.prompt_en: A top-down view of a bench with tools arranged in a half-circle reach zone right in front of the work spot. No people.
shots.narration: 工具材料，放在身体正前方。

shots.scene: 一手撑台、一手伸远够瓶子的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person leaning on one hand while stretching the other arm far across a bench, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别一手撑着，一手去够远处的东西。

shots.scene: 扭腰和蜷缩在角落的姿势图标被划掉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons of a twisted torso and a cramped crouched posture, both crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 少扭转，也别把自己挤在角落里。

shots.scene: 循环箭头和一条手臂反复伸出的图标
shots.prompt_en: A looping arrow icon around an arm that reaches out again and again. No people.
shots.narration: 同一个动作反复做，会越来越累。

shots.scene: 电量逐渐下降的电池图标
shots.prompt_en: A battery icon draining from full to low with a small warning light. No people.
shots.narration: 累了，是身体在提醒你歇一歇。

shots.scene: 小研放下移液器，活动手指和肩膀
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts down a pipette and gently rolls her shoulders and flexes her fingers.
shots.narration: 换换动作，定时小休，松松肌肉。

shots.scene: 用力拧紧瓶盖的手出现红色压力线，被划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand straining hard to twist a stuck bottle cap, with red strain lines, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 干活别用蛮力。

shots.scene: 老李用合适的开瓶工具轻松拧开
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer opens a stuck cap easily using a proper grip tool.
shots.narration: 费劲的时候，换个合适的工具。

shots.scene: 太大的手套、太紧的手套、合手的手套三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three glove icons: one too large and baggy, one too tight, and one well-fitting with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 手套合不合手，关系到手的健康。

shots.scene: 宽大厚手套握瓶，手腕肌腱处出现红色
shots.prompt_en: A hand in a baggy thick glove gripping a bottle tightly, with red marks along the tendons of the wrist. No faces.
shots.narration: 太大太厚，得使劲握，肌腱会肿痛。

shots.scene: 腕口勒紧的手套，腕管处出现红色
shots.prompt_en: A glove with a tight stiff cuff squeezing the wrist, with a red mark over the inner wrist. No faces.
shots.narration: 太紧太硬，会压迫腕部神经血管。

shots.scene: 小研从不同尺码的手套盒中挑选
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student picks gloves from boxes of different sizes with blank labels.
shots.narration: 选合手、舒适、适合任务的手套。

shots.scene: 阿杰长时间盯着显微镜，眼睛周围有疲劳线
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks into a microscope for a long time, with small tired lines drawn near his eyes.
shots.narration: 久看显微镜和电脑，眼睛会疲劳。

shots.scene: 阿杰闭上眼，用掌心轻轻捂住双眼
shots.prompt_en: The young male student closes his eyes and gently cups his palms over them.
shots.narration: 闭上眼，用掌心捂一会儿。

shots.scene: 带循环箭头的时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon with a repeating arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 闭眼约一分钟，隔一阵做一次。

shots.scene: 小研从显微镜抬头，望向窗外远处
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student looks up from a microscope and gazes at trees far outside the window.
shots.narration: 把视线移到远处的一个点。

shots.scene: 眼睛图标旁的远近两个焦点
shots.prompt_en: An eye icon with a near focus point and a far focus point, an arrow moving from near to far. No people.
shots.narration: 看上60到90秒，让眼部肌肉放松。

shots.scene: 小研回到显微镜前，神情轻松
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student returns to the microscope looking relaxed.
shots.narration: 再回来做近处的精细活。

shots.scene: 身体轮廓的颈椎和腰椎被高亮
shots.prompt_en: A side-view body outline with the neck and lower spine highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 背和颈，特别容易受伤。

shots.scene: 搬错、摔倒、驼背三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: lifting with a bent back, slipping on a floor, and slouching at a desk. No people.
shots.narration: 搬错、摔倒、姿势不好，都会伤腰。

shots.scene: 直背的侧面轮廓打勾，弯腰扭身被划掉
shots.prompt_en: A straight-back side outline with a green check next to a bent and twisted outline crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 背颈挺直，不乱弯、不乱扭。

shots.section_title: 坐姿：腰有支撑，脚有着落
shots.scene: 老周坐在靠背椅上，腰部贴着椅背
shots.prompt_en: The older man sits in a lab chair with his lower back resting against the backrest.
shots.narration: 坐着，其实很累腰。
overlay: 坐姿：腰有支撑，脚有着落

shots.section_title: 坐姿：腰有支撑，脚有着落
shots.scene: 腰部和椅背之间的支撑示意
shots.prompt_en: A side-view diagram of a seated person with the lower back curve supported by the chair backrest, highlighted green. No people.
shots.narration: 让椅背托住腰部。

shots.section_title: 坐姿：腰有支撑，脚有着落
shots.scene: 双脚平放在地面的特写
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of two feet resting flat on the floor under a chair. No faces.
shots.narration: 双脚平放在地上。

shots.section_title: 坐姿：腰有支撑，脚有着落
shots.scene: 侧面示意：坐姿中膝盖略高于髋部
shots.prompt_en: A side-view diagram of a seated person whose knees sit slightly higher than the hips, feet flat on the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 膝盖略高于髋部。

shots.section_title: 坐姿：腰有支撑，脚有着落
shots.scene: 腰后放一个靠垫或卷起的毛巾
shots.prompt_en: A small cushion and a rolled towel placed behind the lower back on a chair. No people.
shots.narration: 腰托不够，就垫个靠垫或毛巾卷。

shots.section_title: 坐姿：腰有支撑，脚有着落
shots.scene: 脚下放一个稳固的脚踏
shots.prompt_en: A sturdy footrest under a chair, with feet resting on it. No faces.
shots.narration: 脚够不着地，就加个脚踏。

shots.scene: 阿杰坐在无靠背的实验凳上，身体前倾
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sits on a lab stool without a backrest, leaning forward slightly.
shots.narration: 很多实验凳没有腰托。

shots.scene: 弓背坐凳的图标被划掉，挺直坐打勾
shots.prompt_en: A hunched-on-stool icon crossed out with a red X next to an upright-on-stool icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 臀部往前挪一点，免得弓背。

shots.scene: 双脚踩在凳子横撑上
shots.prompt_en: Feet resting on the footrail of a lab stool. No faces.
shots.narration: 把凳子横撑当脚踏，常起来活动。

shots.scene: 小研站在台前，所需材料都在手边
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands at a bench with all her materials laid out within easy reach.
shots.narration: 久站也累腰，先把东西摆到手边。

shots.scene: 弯腰俯身的图标被划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person stooping low over a bench, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 少弯腰，少俯身。

shots.scene: 一只脚踩在矮脚踏上，两脚交替
shots.prompt_en: One foot resting on a low footrest while the other stays on the floor, with a swap arrow. No faces.
shots.narration: 两只脚轮流受力，可以踩个脚踏。

shots.scene: 防疲劳垫和软底鞋
shots.prompt_en: A cushioned anti-fatigue mat on the floor and comfortable closed-toe shoes with cushioned insoles. No people.
shots.narration: 穿软底舒适的鞋，站在防疲劳垫上。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在一个纸箱前打量
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at a closed cardboard box on the floor, sizing it up.
shots.narration: 搬东西前，先掂量自己搬不搬得动。

shots.scene: 侧面示意：靠近、直背屈膝下蹲
shots.prompt_en: A side-view diagram: a person steps close to a box, keeps the back straight and bends at the knees. No people.
shots.narration: 靠近它，背挺直，屈膝慢慢蹲下。

shots.scene: 弯腰去搬的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person bending at the waist with straight legs to lift a box, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要直腿弯腰去搬。

shots.scene: 阿杰抓牢纸箱两侧，用腿起身，箱子贴近胸前
shots.prompt_en: The young male student grips both sides of the box and rises using his legs, holding it close to his chest.
shots.narration: 抓牢两侧，用腿起身，贴近胸前。

shots.scene: 抱箱转身时扭腰的图标被划掉，用脚转身打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: twisting the torso while holding a box crossed out with a red X, and turning with the feet with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 转身时用脚转，不扭腰。

shots.scene: 阿杰抱着箱子贴身行走
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks holding the box close to his body.
shots.narration: 东西始终贴近身体。

shots.scene: 阿杰屈膝把箱子轻轻放下
shots.prompt_en: The young male student keeps his back straight and bends his knees to set the box down gently.
shots.narration: 放下时反过来：直背、屈膝、轻放。

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰面对面蹲下合抬一个大箱子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student squat face to face and lift a large box together.
shots.narration: 太重太大，别逞强，找人一起抬。

shots.scene: 两人张口数口令的对话气泡图标
shots.prompt_en: Two speech bubble icons with a counting rhythm symbol between two lifting pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 喊着口令，一起用力。

shots.scene: 老李推着装箱子的手推车
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pushes a sturdy cart carrying boxes down a corridor.
shots.narration: 没人帮或太重，就用推车。

shots.scene: 阿杰在操场跑步，小研骑车
shots.prompt_en: The young male student jogs on a campus track while the female graduate student rides a bicycle nearby.
shots.narration: 规律锻炼，让身体保持好状态。

shots.scene: 欣欣做伸展热身动作
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot does a simple arm and shoulder stretch.
shots.narration: 上班前热热身，休息时活动活动。

shots.scene: 身体轮廓和工位图标之间亮起绿色
shots.prompt_en: A body outline and a workstation icon both glowing green with a heart icon above. No people.
shots.narration: 多留意姿势和环境，酸痛会少很多。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起手指，身边出现七个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises a hand as seven small icons appear around it.
shots.narration: 人机工效，记住这几条。

shots.scene: 前四个要点图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: Four icons light up: tools within reach, an adjustable chair, a looping arrow with a pause sign, and a lumbar cushion. No people.
shots.narration: 东西放手边，调台面椅凳，

shots.scene: 后三个要点图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: Three icons light up: lifting with bent knees, a running shoe, and a light bulb for common sense. No people.
shots.narration: 用腿搬举，多锻炼，按规矩来。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现手腕、肩膀和座椅图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a straight wrist, relaxed shoulders and an adjustable chair.
shots.narration: 手腕伸直，上臂贴身，调好台椅。

shots.scene: 循环箭头、暂停符号和眼睛图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a looping arrow with a pause sign and an eye looking at a distant tree. No people.
shots.narration: 重复要小休，眼累远眺一会儿。

shots.scene: 腰托和防疲劳垫图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a lumbar cushion on a chair and an anti-fatigue mat. No people.
shots.narration: 坐有腰托，站有软垫。

shots.scene: 屈膝搬举、两人合抬和推车图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a knee-bent lift, two people lifting together and a cart. No people.
shots.narration: 屈膝直背搬，太重找人用推车。

shots.scene: 规则本和灯泡图标，旁边一扇打开的家门
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a rule book and a light bulb, next to an open front door of a home. No people.
shots.narration: 按规则加常识，每天舒服回家。

shots.scene: 欣欣伸个懒腰后向镜头挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot finishes a stretch and waves goodbye at the camera beside a tidy bench.
shots.narration: 姿势对了，天天轻松，下次见！
